lyrics:
[Intro: slow piano figure, soft pad, crickets]

[Verse 1: whispering female voice]
Click, and the blue goes out
The water turns to ink
Nobody told the two of us
So we don't move, we don't think

[Section: piano and pad, no beat, wordless humming]

[Verse 2: voice barely louder]
Then one white coin
Comes up from underneath
The whole sky's in the deep end
Shaking like a leaf

[Beat Enters: slow kick, brushed snare, bass]

[Chorus: voice doubled, strings]
After the pool lights
There's only the moon
After the pool lights
There's only me and you
And nothing we have to do

[Instrumental: piano melody over the slow beat, strings]

[Chorus: voice doubled, strings]
After the pool lights
There's only the moon
After the pool lights
There's only me and you
And nothing we have to do

[Outro: piano alone, slowing, one drop in water]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 90 BPM, 4/4, D-flat major. Very slow, dreamy and patient; the beat does not enter until halfway.

VOICE: Female, whispering and close, almost spoken, with long pauses. Doubled softly in the choruses. She hums wordlessly between the verses.

INSTRUMENTS: A soft, slow piano figure, warm pads, a slow kick and brushed snare that enter late, a deep rounded bass, a string section, a glockenspiel, crickets and a single drop of water.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano. 0:24 Verse 1. 0:56 Humming, no beat. 1:20 Verse 2. 1:52 Beat enters. 2:08 Chorus 1. 2:40 Instrumental. 3:12 Chorus 2. 3:44 Outro, piano slowing, a drop at 4:24.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s dream pop and downtempo: soft, wide and warm, long reverbs, the voice right at the ear.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The beat arriving at 1:52.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 2:30 a.m. The slowest vocal track in the set, for when almost everyone has gone.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hushed, watching, awed, at rest.
